# Paper 14: Mamba (2023)

*Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces* · Module 4 — Scaling, adaptation and alignment · [Track on the site](https://arubad.github.io/AI_Research_Journey/#paper-14)

## Study approach
Continuous SSM → zero-order-hold discretization → why LTI models (S4) fail selective copying and induction heads. Input-dependent $B, C, \Delta$ break the convolution, requiring a parallel associative scan (Blelloch 1990). $O(N)$ with Transformer-quality modeling.

## Break-it experiments
1. **HAND→AGENT** — Synthetic selective-copying dataset; static LTI recurrence vs selective ($B_t = W_B x_t$); LTI fails to filter variable-spaced noise.
   - Code: `experiments/exp1_synthetic_selective_copying_data.ipynb`
2. **HAND** — Blelloch prefix-sum scan in PyTorch, $O(N)$ sequential → $O(\log N)$ parallel.
   - Code: `experiments/exp2_blelloch_prefix_sum_scan_in_pyto.ipynb`
